---
title: "Debug Metrics"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: true
#| warning: true

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
library(bipartite)

# Load Data directly
# Assuming functions are available or we verify data loading
# Try sourcing the function script if needed, or just loading the package

if (!require("HanPolNet")) {
    devtools::install("local_packages/HanPolNet", upgrade = "never")
    library(HanPolNet)
}

# Load main data
interaction_data_all_22_24 <- get_interaction_data(
    years = c(22, 23, 24),
    is_pollinator = TRUE,
    remove_zeros = TRUE,
    standardize = TRUE
)

cat("DATA_DEBUG_START\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(interaction_data_all_22_24), "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(interaction_data_all_22_24), collapse=", "), "\n")

cat("Years present:\n")
print(table(interaction_data_all_22_24$year))

cat("Sample Rows:\n")
print(head(interaction_data_all_22_24))

cat("Checking Plant Names:\n")
# Guess column
plant_cols <- c("plant_species", "plant_id", "plant")
found_plant <- intersect(plant_cols, names(interaction_data_all_22_24))
if(length(found_plant) > 0) {
    print(unique(interaction_data_all_22_24[[found_plant[1]]]))
} else {
    cat("NO PLANT COL\n")
}
cat("DATA_DEBUG_END\n")

```
